title: In reply to the comment on “Does preoperative joint space affect accuracy in splint-based Le Fort I osteotomy?”
html: We sincerely thank Posnick et al. for their interest in our study1, and most importantly the insightful points raised. We are especially pleased to not only see that our study sparked interest in this clinically important yet underexplored topic, but also to be given an opportunity to further discuss and ultimately enhance our ability to draw actionable insights from quantitative analysis of data.
